name: grokbot
description: Grok (xAI) as one mod, with an account behind it. Sign in from the website with a wallet — that mints the same mod-protocol token every module in this fleet verifies — and the address inside it is the account your xAI key and your saved bots hang off. A grokbot is a name, a model and a system prompt; chat runs one, with live search over X and the web when you ask for it, and the citations come back with the text. BYOK throughout: every call spends the caller's own xAI credits, keys are stored 0600 under ~/.mod/grokbot and never in this repo. One port serves the REST API, the browser console and ten MCP tools off the same client, so an agent, a shell and a human never see different answers.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies
frontend: console.html — wallet sign-in, key, bots, chat; served at /grokbot
state: ~/.mod/grokbot — users/<address>.json (0600, xAI key + bots), key.json (the operator's fallback key), owner.json. Nothing private is ever written into this repo.

auth.signin: mod-protocol token — personal_sign over {data,time}, minted by the wallet in the console or by m.mod('auth')().token({})
auth.byok_header: x-xai-key: xai-… (a key for one call, stored nowhere)
auth.standings: owner (first signed caller, sees /stats) · signed (own key, own bots) · anon (reads, or chats with a per-request key)

endpoints.me: GET /me — who this token is, whether a key is on file, your bots
endpoints.keyinfo: GET /keyinfo — what xAI says about the key itself
endpoints.chat: POST /chat {prompt|messages, model, system, bot, temperature, max_tokens, search, stream}
endpoints.bots: GET /bots | POST /bots {name, system, model, temperature, search} | DELETE /bots?name=
endpoints.raw: POST /raw {path, method, body, params} — any xAI route
endpoints.stats: GET /stats — accounts and bots on this deployment (owner only)

env.XAI_API_KEY: operator fallback key, checked before the keystore
env.GROKBOT_OPEN: 1 collapses every caller into one local identity (no wallet in front of the box)
env.GROKBOT_TOKEN_MAX_AGE: seconds a signed token stays valid (default 604800)
env.GROKBOT_CACHE_TTL: seconds the model list is cached (default 600)
